query: What AI-related announcements has NIST/CAISI made between August 1 and August 19, 2026? List all news items on nist.gov/caisi and NIST news releases in August 2026.
answer:
Research complete. The headline finding for your Aug 10 – Sept 3 window question:

**No new CAISI agreement announcements occurred in August 1–19, 2026.** CAISI's news feed has been silent since July 23, 2026, and the last agreement of any kind was **May 5, 2026** (Google DeepMind, Microsoft, xAI) — a 106-day gap as of today.

Three things worth flagging for your forecast:

1. **The Aug 12 "update" is a trap.** The Kimi K3 page footer reads "Released July 23, 2026, Updated August 12, 2026." If a resolution source scrapes update timestamps rather than release dates, this could look like an August CAISI item. It isn't — it's a revision to a July report.

2. **August NIST AI news is all non-CAISI.** The Genesis Mission MOU (Aug 4), TEVV-Athlon draft (Aug 7), and NVD RFI (Aug 12) came from the Genesis team, ITL, and the cybersecurity program respectively. If the question keys on "NIST AI announcements" broadly rather than CAISI specifically, the answer changes materially.

3. **CAISI is leaderless.** Chris Fall resigned ~July 20 after three months; NIST Director Arvind Raman is acting director with no successor named. Combined with the post-May agreement drought and $10M FY2026 funding, the organizational conditions for a new agreement announcement in the remaining window (Aug 20 – Sept 3) look weak — though I'll note that's context, not a prediction.

One caveat on method: NIST's news listing pages are JS-rendered and returned nothing useful on direct fetch, and `/news-events/news/2026/08` 404s. There's also no Wayback snapshot of nist.gov/caisi at or before today. So the negative finding rests on convergent evidence (search-index full-page captures with "Released…Updated…" footers, the CAISI tag page's reverse-chronological extraction, the GovDelivery bulletin archive, Federal Register) rather than one authoritative dated index.

key_facts: No new CAISI news item, agreement, MOU, CRADA, RFI, or model evaluation was published between August 1 and August 19, 2026.
The newest item on the CAISI 'News and Updates' feed is 'UK AISI / CAISI Preliminary Assessment of Kimi K3's Cyber Capabilities,' released July 23, 2026.
The only August 2026 activity on a CAISI page is a content update: the Kimi K3 page footer reads 'Released July 23, 2026, Updated August 12, 2026' — an update, not a new announcement.
The most recent CAISI agreement announcement of any kind was May 5, 2026: agreements with Google DeepMind, Microsoft and xAI for frontier AI national security testing.
CAISI made three agreement-type announcements in 2026 (GSA MOU Mar 18, OpenMined CRADA Mar 27, Google/Microsoft/xAI May 5) and none since May 5, 2026.

August 4, 2026: NIST published 'NIST Joins National Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI Innovation,' announcing an MOU with the DOE Office of Science — the only NIST AI news release proper in the Aug 1-19 window. Not a CAISI item.

August 7, 2026: NIST announced the initial public draft of NIST AI 200-2, 'The TEVV-Athlon Framework for Evaluating AI Systems,' with a 60-day comment period closing October 6, 2026. This is an ITL product, not CAISI.

August 12, 2026: NIST published a Federal Register RFI (2026-16371, 91 FR 52042) on Modernizing the National Vulnerability Database in the Age of Artificial Intelligence, plus an accompanying Cybersecurity Insights blog. Comments due October 13, 2026.
NIST told Nextgov/FCW that the NVD RFI is not a response to any specific executive order or the Gold Eagle Initiative.
The NIST ITL AI Program page states 'NIST launched the AI Technology Evaluation (AITE) in August 2026,' although the AITE news release itself was dated July 27, 2026.
Both the NIST 'AI Standards' page and the 'NIST ITL AI Program' page carry an 'Updated August 14, 2026' stamp.
The CAISI Research Blog's newest post remains 'Insights into AI Agent Security from a Large-Scale Red-Teaming Competition,' dated March 23, 2026.

CAISI Director Chris Fall resigned around July 20, 2026, after roughly three months in the role; NIST Director Arvind Raman is acting CAISI director, with no permanent successor announced as of August 19, 2026.

CAISI received $10 million in FY2026 funding, equal to each of the prior two fiscal years. H.R. 9363 would provide $20 million/year; Rep. Jay Obernolte has said the real need is closer to $100 million/year.
OSTP Director Michael Kratsios told the House Science Committee around July 22, 2026 that 'CAISI can certainly benefit from more resources.'
As of the May 5, 2026 announcement, CAISI had completed more than 40 evaluations, including of state-of-the-art models that remain unreleased.
All five major U.S. frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft, xAI) are under CAISI evaluation agreements.

NIST news listing pages are JavaScript-rendered and did not yield dated lists on direct fetch; https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2026/08 returns HTTP 404. No Wayback snapshot of nist.gov/caisi exists at or before 2026-08-19, so the negative finding rests on convergent sources rather than a single authoritative dated index.
